title: Section 105 — appointment and limits of a proxy

content.body: Educational example, not an official statutory illustration: A member entitled to attend and vote appoints another person in writing as proxy. The proxy may attend and vote on the member's behalf subject to s. 105 and applicable rules, but s. 105's proviso does not give the proxy a right to speak and permits voting only on a poll. Check the Act, applicable rules and the company's articles for the specific meeting.
